_comment: The catalogue. Prices are per GRAM and are meant to sit near what these things really
cost on an American street, so a number in the wheel means something outside the game.
id          stable key; never change it once a save references it
name        what it is called in the UI
tag         three or four letters for the wheel glyph
tier        0-5, used for how much respect a sale is worth
basePrice   STREET price per gram, before night, turf, rank and market
bulkPrice   WHOLESALE price per gram, what a supplier charges you for weight.
Set per product rather than derived from a flat discount: the gap between
wholesale and street is much wider on powder than it is on weed, and a single
percentage across the catalogue made cheap product unbuyable and expensive
product free money. Leave it at 0 to fall back to the old flat discount.
heatFactor  how much attention a sale draws, relative to 1.0
splitVerb   what cutting it is called -- Cut, Bag up, Press
unitName    what a unit of it is called -- grams, baggies, pills
